name: Masala Chai
subtitle: black tea boiled hard with milk, ginger and whole spices

ingredients.note: crushed, not sliced, so it gives up its heat

prepNotes: Chai is boiled, not steeped. The tea, spices, milk and sugar go through several hard boils together.
Crush the ginger and cardamom rather than chopping. Bruised, they release more into a short boil.

steps.text: Bring the water to the boil with the crushed ginger and whole spices, and let it boil 3 minutes.
steps.tip: Water and spices first, alone. Milk added now would blunt them.

steps.text: Add the tea leaves and boil 2 minutes until very dark.
Pour in the milk and the sugar and bring it back to a rolling boil.
Let it rise up the pan, pull it off the heat as it climbs, and return it. Do this three times.
steps.tip: The repeated rise is what thickens chai and marries the milk with the tea.

steps.text: Strain into cups from a height so it froths.

storage: Make it fresh. Reheated chai turns bitter and stewed. The dry spice mix keeps a month in a jar.
